notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least four cards in their hand.
description:
Cast Rousing Refrain by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting an opponent with at least four cards in their hand.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Rousing Refrain.
Resolve the copy of Rousing Refrain, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
